name: Wettercafe
kurzbeschreibung: Wettercafe at the Triumphpforte in Innsbruck: meteorology and alpine climatology in an urban gastronomy setting, coffee, snacks and Augustiner on tap.
beschreibung: The Wettercafe at Leopoldstraße 2 in Innsbruck combines urban gastronomy with meteorology and alpine climatology – a concept opened in 2010 by publican and meteorologist Mag. Christian Zenkl. Not far from the Triumphpforte and just a stone's throw from the old town, a large screen shows the current weather situation: cloud movements and storm fronts can be followed live across Europe. Culinary-wise, the establishment relies on a deliberately limited but very well-chosen menu; the Augustiner beer on tap is particularly popular. It is complemented by coffee, warming soups and hearty snacks. Zenkl, previously a meteorologist at the ZAMG, also offers weather consultations alongside the food and drink – for example for mountain tours in the Innsbruck area. In 2024, the Innsbruck city senate also approved an outdoor dining area (Gastgarten) in front of the establishment.
